about: Constructed for Lab 11, not real policies: who may read what (users), four restricted records for the Atlas support team, the April version of H02 that the October policy replaced, and four release cases asked as a support agent or a customer. The five course policies in data/support-case.json are unchanged.

restricted.title: Atlas support runbook: longer reset links
restricted.text: Support agents can send a reset link that stays valid for 4 hours to an Atlas workspace owner who is locked out. Do not offer it to other users.

restricted.title: Atlas support runbook: temporary accounts
restricted.text: Support agents reset temporary Atlas accounts from the admin console after they confirm the account's end date.

restricted.title: Atlas support runbook: report exports
restricted.text: Support agents can export all reports of an Atlas workspace when its owner asks in writing.

restricted.title: Atlas incident note: expired links
restricted.text: When a customer says an Atlas reset link expired too soon, check the request time in the admin console before you send a new link.

outdated.title: Atlas expiry
outdated.text: Atlas reset links expire after 24 hours. Request a new link if the old link has expired.
